answer: Withdrawal is gated by a time window plus a retroactive proof channel, and the clawback reaches rewards earned inside the window, which means exiting early forfeits not only the bond but the income earned while the bond was still at risk. The cost of one more head is paid in full and is never amortised across the fleet. A farm waits out a thread, risks a vault, and holds a quartz hostage the entire time: it may abandon the quartz to escape, but then the vault still follows it into the next identity it registers. Every short-lived identity forfeits its bond and the rewards earned under it.
